verdict.rationale: Sumsub documents webhooks that automatically send notifications on applicant verification events, with rollout controls. Client lists are described as inputs to transaction monitoring rules, which implies some rule configuration exists. However, the evidence never describes a general rule engine where users define event conditions that trigger automated actions; webhooks only notify, so the actions themselves must be built on the customer side. missing for 10: documented user-defined event→action rule builder, details on which actions rules can trigger automatically (e.g., auto-reject, re-route level, flag), rule configuration docs beyond a passing mention, independent or hands-on corroboration.
